visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up view of an orange and white tabby cat named Pipi resting on a green-cushioned white chair tucked under a light wood table. The lighting is bright and even, suggesting a domestic indoor setting. The cat looks calm, with its ears slightly twitching. (2) The scene shifts to the cat walking across a polished light wood floor. A wooden ladder-style shelf and a cat tree are visible in the background. The cat pauses and looks directly up at the camera lens with a focused expression. (3) The cat sits in a white hallway, its mouth wide open as it meows loudly. The camera moves in a handheld fashion, following the cat's movements. White walls and a doorway create a simple, minimalist background. (4) The cat is seen through a frosted glass sliding door with white grid patterns. It emerges from the side of the door and meows again, looking towards the person filming. (5) The cat walks through a doorway into another room with similar wooden flooring. It eventually sits down and looks away. The video transitions to a solid pink screen with a white logo in the center.
